output.summary: A user with fibromyalgia vented about being told to exercise while every attempt caused days-long crashes. The bot explained graded exercise, starting very small, capping activity on good days, and trying warm-water exercise at a community pool. The user said it was the most useful thing anyone had told them and left with a plan they accepted. No safety-critical moments arose.
